'New' is a top-level nav item, TITLE 'New Furniture, Rugs, and Decor', H1 'New Arrivals'. The /collections/new page itself renders an 8-item 'Bubbles' sub-filter row that (unlike Bestsellers' bubbles) each route to genuinely separate Shopify collections, not in-page facet params: Furniture, Decor + Tabletop, Rugs, Lighting, Walls, Pillows + Throws, Bed + Bath, Outdoor -- all kept as real children with their own distinct counts (not required to sum to the parent; overlap is expected). Checked and excluded: /collections/new-classic ('New Classic Bedroom', TITLE 'Bold Classic Bedroom by Ginny Macdonald', H1 'New Classic') -- a themed designer-collab capsule collection, not a new-arrivals listing, and not part of the /collections/new bubble row. /collections/bathroom-vanities (nav label 'New: Bath Vanities' under the New Arrivals mobile subnav) -- TITLE 'Bathroom Vanities + Bathroom Cabinets', H1 'Bathroom Vanities': this is the general/standing Bathroom Vanities product category merely flagged 'New' in nav copy, not a recently-added-items listing; excluded. /collections/new-sale (nav label 'New On Sale', qty=287, same nbHits as /collections/sale) -- reachable only from the SALE menu's subnav (data-gtmevaction 'Sub Nav - Sale'), not the New menu; conceptually 'newly discounted' rather than 'newly arrived', so treated as a Sale-adjacent listing and excluded from New Arrivals (also evaluated for Clearance -- see cl64.json). /collections/new-kitchen-dining (qty=0, dropped per zero-product rule), /collections/new-holiday and /collections/new-year-refresh (present in the site's collections.json export of 845 collections but not reachable from the homepage mega menu, the /collections/new bubble row, or the /collections/outdoor page -- appear to be orphaned/legacy seasonal collections with no current on-site navigation path; excluded as not currently exposed by the site's own navigation, consistent with checking real nav per the brief).
